bg.$description: Raised surface of the metric card.

bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the metric surface.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete optional filter behind the metric surface.

border-width.$description: Width of the metric card outline.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the metric card.

padding.$description: Insets around the metric and chart.

gap.$description: Space between the reading and comparison or chart.

trend-gap.$description: Space between the trend glyph and comparison magnitude.

label-fg.$description: Ink of the metric label and comparison period.

label-size.$description: Text size of the metric label.

label-line-height.$description: Line height of the metric label.

value-line-height.$description: Line height of the main reading.

value-letter-spacing.$description: Spacing between digits in the main reading.

emphasis-weight.$description: Weight of the main reading and comparison magnitude.

delta-neutral-fg.$description: Ink of an unchanged or ungraded comparison.

trend-size.$description: Size of the rising or falling trend glyph.
